proves.claim: freezer on an item with a review family, with review.relaxRequiredFamily on and verify.familyRelaxAt set, writes policy.verify.familyRelaxAt into the frozen text.

cli.io-claim.freezer-carries-family-rela.why: Without it no witness can ever fire for a required-family item, since the frozen threshold is the only authority.

proves.claim: with the setting off, or for an item with no review family, the frozen text carries no policy.verify.familyRelaxAt.

cli.io-claim.freezer-omits-family-relax-.why: Without it turning the setting off, or an ordinary item, could still change what a claim freezes.
